subject: Important Update: Changes to Company Policies
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to inform you about the recent changes in our company policies regarding remote work. Moving forward, all employees are required to submit a weekly work log by Friday. This new policy aims to improve communication and accountability within the team. Please review the updated policy document attached to this email for more details. Thank you for your attention and cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name]
